QuizRoom.title: QuizRoom
QuizRoom.description: A live Kahoot-style online quiz room hosted by an authenticated user.

hostId.description: UID of the authenticated user who created and controls the room.

hostName.description: Display name of the room host.

status.description: Current phase of the live quiz session.

difficulty.description: Difficulty preset controlling whether category tags are shown.

questionIds.description: Ordered list of bundled modal quiz question IDs for this session.

currentQuestionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the active question in questionIds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last room state transition (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

OnlinePlayer.title: OnlinePlayer
OnlinePlayer.description: A participant enrolled in a live quiz room with synced score and answer state.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated player (matches document ID).

roomCode.description: Room PIN code denormalized for secure list queries.

displayName.description: Player's display name in the room.

score.description: Cumulative score earned during this session.

lastAnsweredIndex.description: Index of the most recently answered question (-1 if none yet).

lastAnswerCorrect.description: Whether the most recently submitted answer was correct.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player joined (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the player's last update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/quiz_rooms/{roomCode}.description: Live Kahoot-style online quiz rooms keyed by 6-character PIN.

/quiz_rooms/{roomCode}/players/{playerId.description: Participants joined to a specific quiz room, keyed by player UID.
